title: Skill Lint Hooks
description: Pluggable, language-agnostic lint hooks for skills: each hook is a command run against matching files (the pre-commit model), so multi-language skill scripts are checked by per-language tools without changing the core.

id.description: Hook id, used in output and for skipping.

entry.description: Command to run; matched files are passed as arguments.

files.description: Glob of files to run the hook on (default: all).
